name: matricaria chamomilla + mercurius solubilis + sulfur
purpose: Purpose Sensitivity to drafts, soothing fullness, sensitivity to cold itchiness, sensitivity to water
uses: Uses Helps relieve the sensation of fullness of the ear, sensitivity to water and drafts, and the annoyance of water-clogged ears by helping clear water trapped in the ear.
otcwarn: Do not use in the eyes. Initial exacerbation may occur. Ask a doctor before use if you have: ear drainage or discharge pain, irritation, or rash in the ear har ear surgery dizzines Stop use and ask a doctor if: irritation (too much burning) or pain occurs symptoms persist for more than 48 hours
